constraints: The words the record uses. The standard does not classify or grade the condition.
fields.label: Kidney disease as written in the record

constraints: Meaning here: the date chronic kidney disease was recorded as diagnosed. It is not the date diabetes was diagnosed, even though the key is the same in the diabetes element. Often only a year is known; an estimate must stay visible as an estimate.
fields.label: Date chronic kidney disease was recorded as diagnosed

constraints: The value and its unit travel together. No conversion is done here and no value is judged.
fields.label: Creatinine value with its unit

constraints: When the sample was collected, not when the result was filed.
fields.label: Creatinine sample collection time

constraints: The value as the result reports it, with its unit. It is never calculated or checked here and no value is judged.
fields.label: eGFR value as reported

constraints: When the sample behind the reported value was collected.
fields.label: eGFR sample collection time

constraints: The method exactly as the result words it. No method is named as a rule here and none is checked.
fields.label: eGFR method as the result states it

constraints: Meaning here: only that a follow-up arrangement for kidney care is written down, never what it is. It is not the diabetes treatment-plan field and the two are not merged by label.
fields.label: Kidney follow-up arrangement written down

exclusions: Diagnosis, classification, targets and treatment choice.
Any drug, dose or amount of anything given.
intent.population: People recorded as having chronic kidney disease. No narrower scope is assumed.
intent.purpose: Record what was documented about kidney function tests, and when, so that documentation can be described for local review.
intent.rationale: Documentation and timing questions can be asked without any clinical number, so the second demonstration needs no threshold.
intent.setting: Any care setting that follows people with chronic kidney disease. Narrowing is for the local clinician to declare.

manifest.name: Chronic kidney disease: kidney function documentation

provenance.basis: None. No clinical source and no clinical review.
provenance.origin: Synthetic demonstration written for the second demo (row 4.5b).
